summary: Possible name confusion with logform; no malicious behavior observed
details: Package name resembles the widely-used 'logform' library (a Winston log formatter), which raises a name-confusion concern for developers who may install it by mistake. No exfiltration, install-time fetch-and-execute, silent relay, credential distribution, dropper, or backdoor behavior was observed in this version. Name similarity alone is a subjective signal and is not sufficient to confirm malicious intent without an installer-harm payload, so this is routed to human review rather than auto-blocked.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
